meals.name: Spinach and mushroom omelette
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Slice the mushrooms and cook them in the oil for 3 minutes, then add the spinach until wilted.
Step 2: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt, pour over the vegetables and cook on low heat.
Step 3: Sprinkle the cheese, fold and serve.
Optional if you have it: spinach, mushroom, cheddar cheese.

meals.name: Use-it-up egg fried rice
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the protein in the oil (eggs last), then the chopped vegetables for 4 minutes.
Step 2: Add the cooked grain and fry 3 minutes; season with soy sauce or salt.
Optional if you have it: spinach, kale, mushroom, bell pepper, zucchini, tomato, onion, carrot, peas, corn, soy sauce, lettuce, cucumber, sweet potato, potato, avocado, garlic.

meals.name: One-pan chicken thigh and rice
meals.recipe:

Step 2: Add the onion, peas and rice with a splash of water, cover and cook 10 minutes.
Optional if you have it: peas, onion.

meals.name: Tofu tomato curry
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Soften the onion, add the curry spice and tomato and simmer 5 minutes.
Step 2: Add the cubed tofu and spinach for 5 minutes and serve with rice.

Step 2: Top with whatever fruit and nuts you have.
Optional if you have it: banana, apple, orange, strawberries, blueberries, walnuts, almonds, milk.

meals.name: Sweet potato black bean bowl
meals.recipe:

Step 2: Serve with the warm beans, kale and avocado and squeeze over the lemon.
Optional if you have it: lemon.

meals.recipe:

Step 2: Toss the spinach, cucumber and avocado with lemon and oil, then flake the salmon on top.
Optional if you have it: cucumber, lemon.

meals.name: Vegetable frittata
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Soften the vegetables in the oil for 5 minutes.
Step 2: Pour over the beaten eggs and parmesan and cook on low, covered, for 8 minutes.
Optional if you have it: bell pepper, onion, parmesan.

meals.name: Potato cheese omelette
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Fry the thinly sliced potato and onion for 10 minutes.
Step 2: Pour over the eggs, add the cheese and cook covered until set.
Optional if you have it: onion.

meals.name: Steak with potato and broccoli
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Boil the potato 15 minutes and steam the broccoli 4 minutes.
Step 2: Sear the steak 3 to 4 minutes per side and rest.
Step 3: Serve with the butter on the potato.
Optional if you have it: broccoli, butter.
